Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You offer your companion a hand across the room; the world turns, and your places are exchanged.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Two willing creatures within 4 squares, either of which may be yourself.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Exchange their positions by teleportation. Both must be visible and each destination must fit its new occupant. No damage or attacks are granted; the movement does not provoke.
